stable_identity.authority: TAKY verified family session + membership resolver
stable_identity.rule: App-local user ids are never cross-app authority. Consumers bind to verified stable member_id.

shared_basic_profile.update_rule: Monotonic profile_version with same-version collision rejection and strong-store conditional write.
shared_basic_profile.semantic_boundary: family_role is descriptive profile metadata only and MUST NOT grant authorization.

character_profile.rule: Character Visual ID/assets remain separate from basic member profile.

ready_set.rule: READY may publish shared basic fields but cannot redefine family membership.

savey.rule: TAKY shared profile enriches identity/display only. SAVEY finance authority always overlays shared profile.

learning_apps.rule: Basic member profile may provide member_id/school_stage context but does not become learning authority.

ready_set.legacy_user_id_rule: Preserve local userId for compatibility; never promote it to cross-app authority unless already equal to an authorized member_id.
ready_set.multi_member_rule: Guardian flow with multiple eligible members must return MEMBER_SELECTION_REQUIRED; no arbitrary child selection.

savey.projection_rule: SAVEY profile_id is interpreted as TAKY member_id for shared identity projection.

auth_bridge.flow: TAKY verified family session -> fixed SAVEY family_id -> SAVEY FAMILY_MEMBERS finance authority -> signed same-origin HttpOnly session
auth_bridge.rule: TAKY family authorization never supplies SAVEY finance role/parentAccess; SAVEY re-derives those fields from its own canonical FAMILY_MEMBERS.
auth_bridge.system_surface: S-LOGIN APPROVED + LOCAL REGRESSION VERIFIED; auto reconnect on taky-central-auth-ready + manual retry

savey: 155/155 PASS including TAKY->SAVEY auth exchange, shared profile projection, S-LOGIN retry, shared HTTP normalization, and shared queue compatibility regression

gates.production_auth_transport: TAKY-family-domain to SAVEY signed-session bridge is coded and regression-tested; deployed TAKY-shell E2E remains open; no synthetic login promoted to production
